_comment: The assistant's voice inside the Founding Circle portal.
One line = one pre-rendered mp3 in public/audio/narrator/<id>.mp3.
Rendered ONCE, offline, by `npm run narration`. The browser only ever plays
a static file, so a member costs nothing, waits for nothing, and the
greeting cannot break because an API key is missing on the host.
Same voice as obrinex.space's /join flow (aura-2-thalia-en), so the person
who applied and the person who got in are greeted by the same voice.
These lines are generic on purpose. A greeting that said the member's name
would have to be synthesised per person at runtime — which is a paid API
call on every page open, a second and a half of latency before anyone hears
'Hi', and a silent failure the day the key rotates.

lines._note: Spoken once each time a member opens the portal. Short by necessity — it plays while the page is still settling, and anything longer becomes something to sit through rather than something to be greeted by.
lines.text: Hi, valuable member. Glad to see you today.
